season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Atonement
movement.line: Name it. Bring it. Be cleansed.

x: And the Lord passed by before his face, and proclaimed, The Lord God, pitiful and merciful, longsuffering and very compassionate, and true,

and keeping justice and mercy for thousands, taking away iniquity, and unrighteousness, and sins; and he will not clear the guilty; bringing the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and to the children's children, to the third and fourth generation.

days.t: As far as the east is from the west
x: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor recompensed us according to our iniquities.
For as the heaven is high above the earth, the Lord has [so] increased his mercy toward them that fear him.
As far as the east is from the west, [so far] has he removed our transgressions from us.

days.t: He will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea
x: He will return and have mercy upon us; he will sink our iniquities, and they shall be cast into the depths of the sea, [even] all our sins.

days.t: Though your sins be as purple, I will make them white
x: And come, let us reason together, saith the Lord: and though your sins be as purple, I will make them white as snow; and though they be as scarlet, I will make [them] white as wool.

days.t: Create in me a clean heart
x: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit in my inward parts.
Chaph. For he that has brought down will pity, and [that] according to the abundance of his mercy.
